title: release r22: quarantine defective auto inversions — restore reviewed baseline (652 hazards)
head: data-verify-batch-003
body:
## Summary

- Live sampling exposed defective machine-inverted titles (list prefixes, 应-mangled compounds like 相适未/未急储存). ALL 984 auto-inverted hazards (batches 2-4) quarantined; 930 orphan links and 328 orphan reviews removed. Only the 24 hand-written batch-1 inversion hazards remain.
- Baseline restored: 652 hazards / 174 laws / 830 links, strictBlockers=0. r22 shipped.
- The inversion generator stays quarantined until it is rewritten with modal-aware inversion AND every generated title passes human review.
